data.name: Abadiya
data.gender_notes: Abadiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘abd, meaning ‘slave’ or ‘servant’. The suffix ‘-iya’ denotes a female. This name is often used to describe a woman who is productive, prosperous, and abundant in her endeavors. In Islamic tradition, Abadiya represents the devout servant of Allah, striving to achieve the blessings of a fruitful and prosperous life.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of fertility, prosperity, and dedication to Allah.
data.etymology: Abadiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fruitful, Prosperous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abadiya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
